scenarios.reasoning: The agent was inefficient (68 tool calls, ~287s) and missed the central finding: that App.config contains a binding redirect for DiagnosticSource specifying newVersion=10.0.0.3, which is the root cause of the version mismatch. The agent only searched the text log output and never read the actual App.config file. While it correctly identified AutoGenerateBindingRedirects=true and found the RAR conflict message, it drew the wrong conclusion about why 10.0.0.3 appears, attributing it to transitive dependencies rather than the App.config binding redirect. Two of the four rubric criteria were completely missed.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect how RAR processes binding redirects across TFMs

rubricScores.criterion: Found the AppConfigFile property value for the net8.0 inner build
Located the binding redirect entry for DiagnosticSource in App.config
Explained that the binding redirect specifies newVersion=10.0.0.3 which conflicts with the net8.0 assembly version 10.0.0.0
Noted that AutoGenerateBindingRedirects is already enabled, making the manual redirect unnecessary
